summary: Develop practical Excel audit analytics skills with Power Query, fraud testing, dashboards, and workpapers. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Excel-based audit analytics helps auditors, fraud examiners and forensic accountants turn transaction data into documented evidence and testable exceptions. Participants practice cleaning and validating populations with Power Query, building formula-based tests and PivotTable analyses, and preparing reconciliations and sampling schedules. They also learn to document workpapers, screen for fraud indicators and create introductory dashboards; advanced forensic analytics and automated workflows are introduced operationally rather than implemented at production level.
audienceIntro: Excel for auditors and fraud examiners is designed for professionals who already work with spreadsheets and need stronger analytical control over audit evidence, fraud indicators, and investigation workpapers.
modules: Excel Data Quality and Power Query
Power Pivot, DAX, and Digital Workflows
Audit Reporting and Investigation Action Plans
prerequisites: You should have practical experience with Microsoft Excel worksheets, filters, sorting, basic formulas, and working with tabular business data. No programming is required for completion, and the course focuses on operational application rather than technical engineering. Advanced topics such as DAX, Benford's Law, and automated refresh workflows are taught at introductory operational level, while formula testing, Power Query preparation, reconciliations, and audit workpapers receive hands-on practice.
